title: Post-review fix cycle for Story 1.5 lane C (reachable cap gate, append-only continuation ledger, artifact binding)
summary: One bounded fix cycle applying seven reviewer-defined items to the kit's dispatch adapter: run the continuation-cap gate before the max_cycles check and make the marker's remedy complete; replace the overwritable count with an append-only continuation ledger and refuse re-running a retained cycle in place (closing a cap bypass and count deflation the reviewer reproduced); accept a numeric-string decision cycle; bind the continuation artifact to its story; record sizing-refused continuations; document the unpruned series; registry. Each item pinned by the reviewer's reproduction scripts; frozen launch command texts and the monitor library stay byte-identical.
